resources.string: Needed to show ink on top of your lessons
This device hides that setting. Grant it with ADB: appops set com.maestroseb.marcarpro SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Tap to open. Stop removes the ink layer.

Lets your finger use the apps under the ink while the pen keeps writing, gives each browser tab its own ink, and takes the screenshot when you cut the screen out with the scissors. Marcar Pro replays only your own taps and reads only the browser\'s address bar; nothing leaves the board.
Cutting the screen out onto the whiteboard needs the “Marcar Pro · finger to apps” service.
For your finger to use the apps under the ink, Marcar Pro needs the “Marcar Pro · finger to apps” service.
Tap “Open settings”, choose “Marcar Pro · finger to apps” and turn it on. You only do this once.

This board blocks it for apps installed from a file. Once only:\n1. In the screen that opens, tap ⋮ (top right) › “Allow restricted settings”.\n2. Try again: Marcar Pro will take you to turn on “Marcar Pro · finger to apps”.
Accessibility on: the scissors and the finger on the apps are ready
Drag a tool to move it · “–” takes it out of the ring
Drag a box around what to cut out
The board doesn\'t let apps capture the PC\'s picture. Cut out from the board\'s browser, or in Windows use Win+Shift+S and paste.
Whiteboard · drag with one finger, pinch to zoom
Press and hold to clear the board
Marcar Pro closed · your ink will be here next time
Board cleared · hold the main button to undo
Finger: writes · several pupils at once
Copied · press and hold an empty spot to paste
To paste a picture here, copy it first (in the browser: press and hold the picture › Copy image)
The copied picture couldn\'t be read

Only the panel\'s own Crop can capture the PC\'s picture. Marcar Pro opens it for you and, when you save the cut-out, brings it to the whiteboard. To find that cut-out, Marcar Pro needs to see the panel\'s pictures.

The cut-out is on the whiteboard, but the panel also keeps a copy in Notes/Mark. To delete it right away, Marcar Pro needs “All files access”: turn it on in the screen that opens. Marcar Pro only uses it to delete those cut-outs. If you leave it off, the copies stay in the folder.
Using the apps · tap the cursor to write again
Writing · tap the cursor to use the apps
Using the PC · tap the cursor to write again
Writing · tap the cursor to use the PC
A Marcar Pro update is ready
For Marcar Pro to update itself on this board, tap “Open settings” and turn on “Allow from this source”. You only do this once.
Turn on here, in one go, what Marcar Pro needs. Each button opens the setting; when you come back the list updates itself.
For the scissors and to use the apps with a finger while you write.
For the scissors and the apps with a finger. First: in the app info, ⋮ › Allow restricted settings.
To bring the panel\'s Crop cut-outs of the PC or HDMI to the whiteboard.
Only to delete the copy the panel keeps of each PC cut-out.
“Allow from this source”, so improvements install themselves.
Turn on Permissions › Photos and videos › Allow
Draw around what you want to select, with a finger or the pen
To write on top of everything. Already on.
Only the ongoing “Marcar Pro is on” notice, with its Stop button.
Choose the colour to keep in that dot
You can update now: it takes a few seconds and nothing written is lost. If you prefer later, it will install itself when the panel has been idle for a while or when it is switched on.

resources.string: Boards not opened for 30 days go to the bin. Pinned ones never expire.
They delete themselves after 7 days. The arrow brings one back.
The quick board from the other day is in the bin, in case you need it
